headline: Microsoft's Surface RTX Spark Dev Box up for preorder around $6,000
summary: Microsoft's Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is available for preorder and will ship in November, priced at roughly $6,000 — pricier than Nvidia's DGX Spark mini PC. The Verge cites $5,999 while Engadget rounds the price to $6,000; reviewers describe its design as resembling an oversized Lego brick.
